name: Sky Sportsbar
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Sky Sportsbar in Tirol** – where the thrill of the game meets the charm of the Alps!

Indulge in a lively atmosphere with **big screens**, **top-tier drinks**, and **mouthwatering snacks** while cheering on your favorite teams. Whether it’s **football, basketball, or ice hockey**, we’ve got you covered—just like a true **Tiroler**!

After the match, stay for a **Kaiserschmarrn** breakfast or a hearty **Schweinsbraten** dinner. Our **Apfelstrudel** and **Tiroler Grüner Veltliner** will make you forget you’re not in a cozy **Hütte**!

Located right in the heart of **Innsbruck**, we’re the perfect spot for sports fans and locals alike. Come join us—**Prost und viel Spaß!**

📍 **Sky Sportsbar Tirol**
📍 **Maria-Theresien-Straße 24, 6020 Innsbruck**
📞 **+43 512 123 456** (example number—replace with real contact)
🕒 **Open daily from 10 AM – late!**
